name: Melodic Front
description:
The original purpose of the L-44 'Gramophone' was to defend against wild beasts and criminals. They never served their purpose, and instead ended up carrying the weight of sin.
<'Gramophone'>Both allied and enemy units will fight for control over this device; When activated, deals Arts damage to enemies and heals allies
